profile.headline: Senior Triage Software Engineer at SailPoint
profile.summary:
I am passionate about delivering fantastic customer service while learning new things.  I thrive in challenging, fast-paced environments where creativity and "outside the box" thinking are valued.  

Currently working as a triage engineer in the IAM SaaS space at SailPoint.  Great team and interesting work.

positions.title: Application Support Engineer
positions.description: Escalation team for L3 technical support.  Work with MS SQL, AWS, PowerShell, SalesForce, Jenkins, Git, New Relic, PagerDuty.  Responsible for maintaining complex system integrations for revenue/advertising systems for all iHeart stations in the US (about 950).  Work with developers and users to create improved processes and systems enterprise-wide.  Support legacy proprietary radio scheduling software systems.

positions.title: Agent 2 Technical Support Center
positions.description: Support external customers via phone, email, and online ticketing system on Pyxis MedStation technologies.  Assist other agents with cases.  New agent mentoring.  Support MS3500/4000, ES, Security Module (WSUS & ESET)

positions.title: Systems Technician
positions.description: Single point of contact for end-users technical issues, maintain client hardware, assist with long-range infrastructure planning, manage ticketing queue, maintain asset database, track software licensing, provide proactive support

positions.title: Service Desk Analyst II
positions.description: Tier 2 escalation for phone/online internal helpdesk (5000+ employees), first point of contact for enterprise-wide technical issues, user access management, hardware repair and troubleshooting, support for several internal tools such as ticketing system, chat system, Exchange, Active Directory, SCCM.  Developed knowledge base articles, monitored multiple channels for emerging problems (email, tickets, chat, phone, mailing lists, etc.)

positions.title: Support Specialist
positions.description: Support staff for software company.  Performed on-site installation and training, phone and email technical support, maintained software documentation, maintained office network and hardware, administered SharePoint and Exchange server, Active Directory maintenance

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description: Computer technician at local computer repair shop, bought one location and ran it for 1.5 years.  Performed variety of hardware and software troubleshooting, installation, sales, warranty service, on-site repair, virus and malware removal

positions.title: IT Operations Support Specialist
positions.description: IT support for mixed Windows/Mac/UNIX enviroment at a major newspaper, hardware troubleshooting, software maintenance and upgrades, employee help desk, Y2K conversion

positions.title: QA Lead & Support Technician II
positions.description: Tier 2 escalation for tech support team, liaison between support staff and programming team, maintained network, performed all QA on software prior to release, developed documentation and troubleshooting flowcharts

volunteerExperiences.description: Designed and maintained a website for the HOA pool (http://www.woodstonepool.org).
